features.title: Verify init.sh runs cleanly

Confirm install, verify, and start-command-print steps all succeed

features.notes: Inferred commands: install='go mod download', verify='go build ./...', start='(cd cmd/gateway && go run .)'. Gateway needs FoundationDB client libs (v6.2.27). Runtime requires Redis + etcd + Discord TOKEN. The verify command runs a build only — full tests require infra.

features.title: Backfill-completion marker for RGM skip
features.user_visible_behavior: On reconnect, the gateway can force a targeted shard to IDENTIFY and then skip Request Guild Members for guilds with completed backfill markers, reconciles small guilds straight from the GUILD_CREATE payload, and removes ghost members who left while disconnected — instead of re-requesting every guild's members on every connect.

go test ./internal/state/db/statepsql/ -run 'Backfill|Reconcile|Complete' (4/4 PASS against live PostgreSQL 14)
go test -race ./internal/gatewayws/... ./gatewaypb (PASS - force-identify signal/apply split + 1000-call concurrency race test, protobuf flag round-trip)
./gen.sh (regenerates gatewaypb with zero diff after the go install fix)
STAGING (gateway:58195f2, shards:1): force-identify shard 0 -> 'force identifying shard' / 'discarding resume state' / 'sending identify' (not resume) / 'ready' with fresh session id
STAGING small guild (<=250): delete members+marker, force-identify -> roster repopulates from inline GUILD_CREATE, no RGM, marker re-stamped via reconcile

features.notes: Implemented on master baseline (not on feat/gate-rgm-on-reidentify, which it supersedes). 2026-06-18 pivot: skip is now NO-EXPIRY (skip if backfilled_at IS NOT NULL, any age) because reconnect-storm speed is the priority — a jittered staleness skip gave no relief for the storm-after-long-uptime case it most needs to help. Drift is bounded by the reconciliation delete on real backfills + cold re-backfills on UNLOGGED cache reset; it only accrues during disconnect windows, so good uptime keeps it small. A Phase 3b background sweep is DEFERRED/OPTIONAL (build only if roster staleness becomes a real complaint), not required. 2026-06-18 force-identify control: RestartShardRequest.force_identify signals the shard (atomic flag) and cancels it; the next Open clears+persists the resume tuple on the read-loop goroutine (rewritten in commit 58195f2 from the original racy in-gRPC-goroutine clear), avoiding DB-delete/pod-shutdown races and a 64-shard pod restart. Status flipped to 'passing' 2026-06-18 after staging validation ran (agent-progress.md Session 002d): no-RGM-storm small-guild reconcile, large-guild auto-RGM + multi-chunk decode, and the skip gate were all confirmed on staging. Observability caveat: the AUTOMATIC RGM path (write.go:187) logs nothing on success (only the manual gRPC path logs 'sending members request') - verify auto-RGM via the DB, not logs. Apply guild_backfills (init.sql, IF NOT EXISTS) to the state DB before deploy; after prod deploy, seed the baseline via one full re-IDENTIFY.
